0022600026.text: Charlotte (3-6, 10th in the East, 4th in the Southeast and 2 games back) hosts Boston (6-2, 3rd in the East, 2nd in the Atlantic and 1.5 games back) in Emirates NBA Cup East Group C play, with the Hornets on a five-game losing streak and the Celtics on a one-game winning streak after starting 5-0 at home. Boston won 2 of three meetings in 2025-26, including a 113-102 win in Boston in their last matchup, and the 2026-27 season series has no games yet. Charlotte is without Grant Williams (out, hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (day-to-day, leg soreness, game-time decision), while Boston is missing Devin Carter (out, illness), Jayson Tatum (day-to-day, rest, game-time decision) and Payton Pritchard (day-to-day, eye abrasion, game-time decision).
